newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Lernout & Hauspie in capital increase deal.
newsitem.headline: Lernout & Hauspie in capital increase deal.

text.p: Belgian high-tech text-to-speech firm Lernout & Hauspie Speech Products said on Friday it had struck a deal for the private placement of $27 million worth of five-year convertible subordinated notes.
It also said it expected approval to raise its bank credit lines to $17 million from $7 million.

The convertible notes, underwritten by a major New York investment bank, and the credit line increase will be used to both buy more hardware and to make a strategic acquisition, the firm said in a statement released from its Belgian and United States headquarters.
"The company intends to use this increased capital to acquire automatic machine translation technology and to strengthen its 'Mendez' language translation services," the firm said.

"The Mendez human translation services will provide a profitable platform for the application and further improvement of machine translation and will allow the company to enter into multilingual Internet services.
"The company is also planning a strategic acquisition to strengthen its position in its core speech technologies," it added. -- Brussels Newsroom +32 2 287 6810, Fax +32 2 230 7710
